hooks.command: { if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then timeout 20 minions hook pre-agent; else perl -e '$t=shift;$p=fork;defined $p or exit 127;if(!$p){setpgrp(0,0);exec @ARGV;print STDERR "$ARGV[0]: $!\n";exit 127}setpgrp($p,$p);$SIG{ALRM}=sub{kill "KILL",-$p;exit 124};alarm $t;waitpid $p,0;exit($?&127?128+($?&127):$?>>8)' 20 minions hook pre-agent; fi; } || exit 2

i=$(cat) || exit 2; case "$i${MINIONS_WORKER_LEASE:+\"agent_id\"}" in *'"agent_id"'*) if [ -z "$MINIONS_WORKER_LEASE" ]; then printf '%s' "$i" | grep -Eq 'minions[^:]|cli\.[cm]?js|/state|/secrets|MINIONS_STATE_DIR|MINIONS_SECRETS_DIR'; m=$?; [ "$m" = 1 ] && exit 0; [ "$m" = 0 ] || exit 2; fi; printf '%s' "$i" | { if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then timeout 20 minions hook pre-bash; else perl -e '$t=shift;$p=fork;defined $p or exit 127;if(!$p){setpgrp(0,0);exec @ARGV;print STDERR "$ARGV[0]: $!\n";exit 127}setpgrp($p,$p);$SIG{ALRM}=sub{kill "KILL",-$p;exit 124};alarm $t;waitpid $p,0;exit($?&127?128+($?&127):$?>>8)' 20 minions hook pre-bash; fi; } || exit 2;; esac
